<!-- Generated by scripts/api.py from apps/pads/api. Do not edit: run python3 scripts/api.py. -->

The Pads API (see the [guide](/guides/api/)). Each procedure is in Odin as
`pads_api.name`, in C as `pads_name` (through the function table
`Pads_Api_V1`), and over the control socket as the method `pads_name`.

## The handle, results, threading and versions

### api_post

```odin
api_post :: proc(api: ^Api, call: Post_Proc, user: rawptr) -> Result
```

Queues `call` to run on the control thread at the next frame, with `user`. Any thread. Its results come back however `user` says (the call writes them there, say).

### api_version

```odin
api_version :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

The API's version (`VERSION`).

### last_error

```odin
last_error :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

Why the last call that failed failed, in words (temporary: until the next failure). "" before any.

## Audio tracks: takes, regions, comping, consolidating, warp

### audio_part

```odin
audio_part :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64) -> (Part_State, Result)
```

Audio track `pad`'s part in sequence `slot`. Unsupported for a pad that isn't an audio track.

### audio_region

```odin
audio_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64) -> (Region, Result)
```

Region `index` of audio track `pad`'s part in sequence `slot`.

### audio_add_take

```odin
audio_add_take :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, path: string, at: f64 = 0) -> Result
```

Adds the audio file at `path` as a take of audio track `pad` in sequence `slot`, at beat `at` (on top of what is there). Undoably; Io_Error if it can't be read.

### audio_split

```odin
audio_split :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, beat: f64) -> Result
```

Splits the region under beat `beat`, undoably.

### audio_delete_range

```odin
audio_delete_range :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, from: f64, to: f64) -> Result
```

Deletes beats `from`..`to` of the part (silence there), undoably.

### audio_crop

```odin
audio_crop :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, from: f64, to: f64) -> Result
```

Keeps only beats `from`..`to` of the part, undoably.

### audio_move_region

```odin
audio_move_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64, at: f64) -> Result
```

Moves region `index` to start at beat `at`, undoably (a gesture's moves merge).

### audio_trim_region

```odin
audio_trim_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64, beat: f64, end: bool) -> Result
```

Moves region `index`'s start (or its end, with `end`) to beat `beat`, undoably.

### audio_delete_region

```odin
audio_delete_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64) -> Result
```

Deletes region `index`, undoably.

### audio_set_region

```odin
audio_set_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64, region: Region) -> Result
```

Sets region `index`'s gain, pan, fades, mute and reversing (its take, place and frames as they are), undoably.

### audio_normalize_region

```odin
audio_normalize_region :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, index: i64) -> Result
```

Raises region `index` so its loudest is full scale, undoably.

### audio_use_take

```odin
audio_use_take :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, take: i64, from: f64, to: f64) -> Result
```

Plays take `take` over beats `from`..`to` (comping: the best of each pass), undoably.

### audio_consolidate

```odin
audio_consolidate :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Renders the part to one take (its regions, fades and gains as it plays), undoably. Busy while it can't yet (a take still being rendered).

### audio_set_warp

```odin
audio_set_warp :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, warp: Audio_Warp, transpose: f32) -> Result
```

How the part follows a tempo it wasn't recorded at, and its transpose (-24..24 semitones; Stretch), undoably.

### audio_clear

```odin
audio_clear :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Clears audio track `pad`'s take in the current sequence, undoably.

## Devices: synth presets, plug-in instruments

### device_preset_count

```odin
device_preset_count :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Built-in synth presets there are (device_preset_name lists them).

### device_preset_name

```odin
device_preset_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Built-in preset `index`'s name ("Warm Pad"). Temporary.

### device_preset_category

```odin
device_preset_category :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Built-in preset `index`'s kind ("Bass", "Pad", "Lead"). Temporary.

### device_load_preset

```odin
device_load_preset :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, index: i64) -> Result
```

Puts built-in preset `index` on pad `pad` (it becomes a synth): one undo step.

### device_load_preset_file

```odin
device_load_preset_file :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, path: string) -> Result
```

Puts the preset saved at `path` on pad `pad` (it becomes a synth): one undo step. Io_Error if it can't be read.

### device_save_preset

```odin
device_save_preset :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, dir: string, name: string) -> (string, Result)
```

Saves synth pad `pad`'s patch as preset `name` in folder `dir`: the file's path. Unsupported for a pad that isn't a synth.

### device_preset_of

```odin
device_preset_of :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

The preset synth pad `pad`'s patch came from ("" if none). Temporary.

### device_load_plugin

```odin
device_load_plugin :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, path: string, id: string, name: string) -> Result
```

Makes pad `pad` play CLAP instrument `id` of the library at `path` (named `name`): one undo step.

## Effects: inserts, bus effects, performance effects, sends, sidechains

### effect_kind_count

```odin
effect_kind_count :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Effect kinds there are (effect_kind_name names them; 0 is empty).

### effect_kind_name

```odin
effect_kind_name :: proc(api: ^Api, kind: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Effect kind `kind`'s name, as the UI shows it ("Reverb", "Low-pass"). Temporary.

### effect_state

```odin
effect_state :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref) -> (Effect_State, Result)
```

What is in slot `s`.

### effect_name

```odin
effect_name :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref) -> (string, Result)
```

The name of what is in slot `s` ("Reverb", a plug-in's; "Empty"). Temporary.

### effect_set

```odin
effect_set :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, kind: i64) -> Result
```

Puts a new effect of kind `kind` (its default settings) in slot `s`, undoably (0: empties it). Unsupported for the plug-in kind (effect_set_plugin) and an empty performance effect.

### effect_set_plugin

```odin
effect_set_plugin :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, path: string, id: string, name: string) -> Result
```

Puts CLAP plug-in `id` from the library at `path` (named `name`) in slot `s`, undoably. Unsupported for a performance effect.

### effect_clear

```odin
effect_clear :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref) -> Result
```

Empties slot `s`, undoably. Unsupported for a performance effect.

### effect_set_on

```odin
effect_set_on :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, on: bool) -> Result
```

Turns the effect in slot `s` on, or bypasses it, undoably. Not_Found for an empty slot.

### effect_swap

```odin
effect_swap :: proc(api: ^Api, a: Slot_Ref, b: Slot_Ref) -> Result
```

Swaps the effects in slots `a` and `b` of one pad's inserts or one bus (or main), undoably: how effects are put in another order.

### effect_get_param

```odin
effect_get_param :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, id: i64) -> (f64, Result)
```

Parameter `id` of the effect in slot `s` (plain units; a performance effect's too: param_get covers the others).

### effect_set_param

```odin
effect_set_param :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, id: i64, value: f64) -> Result
```

Sets parameter `id` of the effect in slot `s` (plain units, in its range), undoably (a touch's or a gesture's moves merge).

### effect_hold

```odin
effect_hold :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64, on: bool, intensity: f32 = -1) -> Result
```

Holds performance effect `index` (it plays while held) at `intensity` (0..1; -1: its own), or lets it go. Not an edit.

### effect_set_intensity

```odin
effect_set_intensity :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64, intensity: f32) -> Result
```

Sets performance effect `index`'s own intensity (0..1): what it plays at when its pad's press doesn't say. Undoably.

### effect_set_send_pre

```odin
effect_set_send_pre :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, send: i64, pre: bool) -> Result
```

Takes pad `pad`'s send to bus `send` + 1 from before its fader (`pre`) or after, undoably. (Its level is a parameter: device Send.)

### effect_key

```odin
effect_key :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref) -> (Key_State, Result)
```

What the effect in slot `s` listens to.

### effect_set_key

```odin
effect_set_key :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, kind: Key_Kind, index: i64) -> Result
```

Makes the effect in slot `s` (a compressor, a gate) listen to `kind` `index` (None: itself; it stops listening), undoably. Invalid_Argument for a key it can't have (itself, or a bus it feeds).

### effect_set_key_filter

```odin
effect_set_key_filter :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, hz: f32) -> Result
```

Sets the key's high-pass (0..2000 Hz; 0: none) of the effect in slot `s`, undoably.

### effect_set_key_listen

```odin
effect_set_key_listen :: proc(api: ^Api, s: Slot_Ref, on: bool) -> Result
```

Makes the track play the key of the effect in slot `s` (filtered) instead, to set it by, or not. Undoably.

## Export: mixdowns, stems, resampling, bouncing, freezing, MIDI files

### export_state

```odin
export_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Export_State, Result)
```

The export under way, or the last one.

### export_file

```odin
export_file :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

File `index` the last export wrote. Temporary.

### export_start

```odin
export_start :: proc(api: ^Api, settings: Export_Settings, path: string) -> Result
```

Exports as `settings` say into `path` (a .wav file; with stems, a folder). It renders a slice a frame: export_state says how far. Busy while another is under way; Invalid_Argument with nothing to export.

### export_now

```odin
export_now :: proc(api: ^Api, settings: Export_Settings, path: string) -> (i64, Result)
```

Exports as `settings` say into `path` at once, waiting for it (a script's export): the files written. Busy while another is under way.

### export_resample

```odin
export_resample :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Resamples the current sequence (as it sounds from main) onto the next empty pad.

### export_bounce_pads

```odin
export_bounce_pads :: proc(api: ^Api, pads: []i64) -> Result
```

Bounces pads `pads` (what they play in the current sequence, after their faders) together onto the next empty pad.

### export_bounce_bus

```odin
export_bounce_bus :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> Result
```

Bounces bus `bus` onto the next empty pad.

### export_bounce_in_place

```odin
export_bounce_in_place :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Bounces pad `pad` in place: an audio track of its sound, the pad muted.

### export_freeze

```odin
export_freeze :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Freezes pad `pad`: its sound rendered in each sequence and played instead (its device and inserts rest).

### export_unfreeze

```odin
export_unfreeze :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Unfreezes pad `pad` (its renderings kept, unused), undoably.

### export_flatten

```odin
export_flatten :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Flattens frozen pad `pad`: an audio track whose takes are its renderings. One undo step.

### export_midi

```odin
export_midi :: proc(api: ^Api, path: string, slot: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

Writes sequence `slot` (-1: the song) as a Standard MIDI File at `path`: the notes it wrote. Io_Error if it can't be written.

### export_import_midi

```odin
export_import_midi :: proc(api: ^Api, path: string, slot: i64, how: Midi_Import = .Drums, pad: i64 = 0) -> (i64, Result)
```

Reads the Standard MIDI File at `path` into sequence `slot` (replacing what is there), its notes onto pads as `how` says: the notes read. Undoably.

## History: undo, redo, groups, gestures

### history_state

```odin
history_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (History_State, Result)
```

The history now.

### history_undo

```odin
history_undo :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Undoes the last step. Not_Found with nothing to undo; Busy while a group is open.

### history_redo

```odin
history_redo :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Redoes the last step undone. Not_Found with nothing to redo; Busy while a group is open.

### history_undo_name

```odin
history_undo_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

What undo would undo ("Set Tempo"), or "" (temporary).

### history_redo_name

```odin
history_redo_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

What redo would redo, or "" (temporary).

### history_step_name

```odin
history_step_name :: proc(api: ^Api, step: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Step `step`'s name, counting along the history: 0 .. undo_steps-1 are the steps done (the oldest first), then the steps undone (the next to redo first). Not_Found past the end. Temporary.

### history_go_to

```odin
history_go_to :: proc(api: ^Api, done: i64) -> Result
```

Undoes or redoes until `done` steps are done (0: all undone; undo_steps + redo_steps: all redone). Invalid_Argument out of that range; Busy while a group is open.

### history_group_begin

```odin
history_group_begin :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Starts a group: the edits until `history_group_end` become one undo step named `name`. Groups nest (the outermost names the step).

### history_group_end

```odin
history_group_end :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Ends the group `history_group_begin` started (an empty group leaves no step). Not_Found when none is open.

### history_gesture_begin

```odin
history_gesture_begin :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Starts a gesture (a knob or a fader held): the edits of one value until `history_gesture_end` merge into one undo step, as a drag's do. Without one, each edit is a step of its own.

### history_gesture_end

```odin
history_gesture_end :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Ends the gesture: the next edit is a new step.

## Launcher: lanes, launching, stopping, Hold, Record to Song

### launcher_state

```odin
launcher_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Launcher_State, Result)
```

The launcher now.

### launcher_lane

```odin
launcher_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> (Lane_State, Result)
```

Lane `lane` now.

### launcher_lane_name

```odin
launcher_lane_name :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Lane `lane`'s name (its own, else its letter's). Temporary.

### launcher_place

```odin
launcher_place :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> (Place, Result)
```

Where sequence `slot` is.

### launcher_slot_at

```odin
launcher_slot_at :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64, row: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

The sequence at `lane`, `row` (-1: none).

### launcher_launch

```odin
launcher_launch :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, alone: bool = false) -> Result
```

Launches sequence `slot` in its lane (`alone`: the other lanes stop), when the launch quantize says; stopped, it starts playing.

### launcher_launch_row

```odin
launcher_launch_row :: proc(api: ^Api, row: i64) -> Result
```

Launches row `row` of every lane (a scene).

### launcher_stop_lane

```odin
launcher_stop_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> Result
```

Stops lane `lane` (when the launch quantize says).

### launcher_stop_all

```odin
launcher_stop_all :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Stops every lane.

### launcher_set_quantize

```odin
launcher_set_quantize :: proc(api: ^Api, q: Launch_Quantize) -> Result
```

When a sequence launched while playing takes over (saved with the project).

### launcher_set_hold

```odin
launcher_set_hold :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Sequence pads play while held (`on`), or launch on a press. Undoably.

### launcher_set_continue

```odin
launcher_set_continue :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

A launch carries on where the playhead is in its lane (`on`), or starts its sequence from the top. Undoably.

### launcher_set_recording

```odin
launcher_set_recording :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Records what is launched into the song (Record to Song), or stops: stopped while playing, the take so far goes into the song.

### launcher_add_lane

```odin
launcher_add_lane :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds a lane (after the others): its number. Busy at 16.

### launcher_delete_lane

```odin
launcher_delete_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> Result
```

Deletes lane `lane` (its sequences go to the others). Busy for the last.

### launcher_rename_lane

```odin
launcher_rename_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Names lane `lane` (up to 15 bytes; "": its letter again), undoably.

### launcher_color_lane

```odin
launcher_color_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64, color: i64) -> Result
```

Colours lane `lane` (0xRRGGBB; 0: its default), undoably.

### launcher_move_sequence

```odin
launcher_move_sequence :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, lane: i64, row: i64) -> Result
```

Moves sequence `slot` to `lane`, `row` (the rows close up behind it), undoably.

### launcher_new_sequence

```odin
launcher_new_sequence :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

A new, empty sequence at the end of lane `lane`: its slot. Busy when every slot is used.

## MIDI: ports, the MIDI map, pads' MIDI in and out

### midi_port_count

```odin
midi_port_count :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

MIDI ports there are now (midi_port_name lists them; in the system's order: open ports may come and go).

### midi_port

```odin
midi_port :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (Midi_Port, Result)
```

MIDI port `index`: an input or an output, and whether it is open.

### midi_port_name

```odin
midi_port_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

MIDI port `index`'s name. Temporary.

### midi_port_id

```odin
midi_port_id :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

MIDI port `index`'s id (stable across runs where the system allows it: what pad inputs and outputs keep). Temporary.

### midi_send

```odin
midi_send :: proc(api: ^Api, status: i64, data1: i64, data2: i64, port: i64 = 0) -> Result
```

Plays a MIDI message (`status`, `data1`, `data2`) into Pads as if it came in on input `port` (its index among the open inputs): a note-on plays what it is mapped to, recorded while recording. Any thread but the audio thread.

### midi_learn

```odin
midi_learn :: proc(api: ^Api, key: i64, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Makes MIDI key `key` (0..127) play pad `pad` (-1: nothing) in the MIDI map, undoably.

### midi_key_of

```odin
midi_key_of :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

The MIDI key that plays pad `pad` (the lowest, if several), or -1.

### midi_pad

```odin
midi_pad :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (Pad_Midi, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s MIDI input and output.

### midi_set_pad_input

```odin
midi_set_pad_input :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, mode: Midi_In_Mode, port_id: string, channel: i64) -> Result
```

What MIDI plays pad `pad`: all ports (the map), none, or port `port_id` (its id: midi_port_id) on `channel` (0: any; 1..16). Undoably.

### midi_set_pad_output

```odin
midi_set_pad_output :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, on: bool, channel: i64, key: i64, port_id: string) -> Result
```

Pad `pad`'s hits also go out as MIDI (`on`): note `key` (0..127) on `channel` (0..15) of output port `port_id` ("": the default output). Undoably.

## Mixer: buses, outputs, groups, cue, meters, loudness, latency

### mixer_state

```odin
mixer_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Mixer_State, Result)
```

The mixer now.

### mixer_bus_state

```odin
mixer_bus_state :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> (Bus_State, Result)
```

Bus `bus` (or MAIN) now.

### mixer_bus_name

```odin
mixer_bus_name :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Bus `bus`'s name ("Bus A", its own, "Main"). Temporary.

### mixer_add_bus

```odin
mixer_add_bus :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds a bus (after the others, going to main): its number. Busy when there are 16.

### mixer_delete_bus

```odin
mixer_delete_bus :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> Result
```

Deletes bus `bus`: what went to it goes to main, its sends go, the buses after it move up. One undo step. Busy for the last bus left.

### mixer_rename_bus

```odin
mixer_rename_bus :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Names bus `bus` (up to 15 bytes; "": its letter again), undoably.

### mixer_set_bus_output

```odin
mixer_set_bus_output :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, output: Output) -> Result
```

Sends bus `bus` to `output`, undoably. Invalid_Argument if that goes round in a loop (to itself, or through buses back to it).

### mixer_set_pad_output

```odin
mixer_set_pad_output :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, output: Output) -> Result
```

Sends pad `pad` to `output` (main, a bus, an output pair), undoably.

### mixer_pad_output

```odin
mixer_pad_output :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (Output, Result)
```

Where pad `pad` plays.

### mixer_set_bus_mute

```odin
mixer_set_bus_mute :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, on: bool) -> Result
```

Mutes bus `bus` (or MAIN) or not, undoably.

### mixer_set_bus_solo

```odin
mixer_set_bus_solo :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, on: bool) -> Result
```

Solos bus `bus` or not, undoably. Unsupported for main.

### mixer_set_bus_volume

```odin
mixer_set_bus_volume :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, db: f32) -> Result
```

Sets bus `bus`'s (or MAIN's) fader (-60..6 dB): param_set on its Volume.

### mixer_set_bus_pan

```odin
mixer_set_bus_pan :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, pan: f32) -> Result
```

Sets bus `bus`'s (or MAIN's) pan (-1..1): param_set on its Pan.

### mixer_group_pads

```odin
mixer_group_pads :: proc(api: ^Api, pads: []i64, name: string) -> (i64, Result)
```

Groups pads `pads` under a new group bus named `name` ("": "Group N"), going where the first went: the bus. One undo step. Busy when there are 16 buses.

### mixer_ungroup

```odin
mixer_ungroup :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> Result
```

Ungroups group bus `bus`: its pads go where it went, and it goes. One undo step. Invalid_Argument for a bus that isn't a group.

### mixer_set_group_folded

```odin
mixer_set_group_folded :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, folded: bool) -> Result
```

Folds group bus `bus`'s pads away in the Mixer, or shows them (a view: saved, not undone).

### mixer_set_pad_cue

```odin
mixer_set_pad_cue :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, db: f32, pre: bool) -> Result
```

Sets pad `pad`'s send to the cue mix (a performer's headphones): `db` (-60: off; up to 6), before its fader (`pre`) or after. Undoably.

### mixer_set_bus_cue

```odin
mixer_set_bus_cue :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64, db: f32, pre: bool) -> Result
```

Sets bus `bus`'s send to the cue mix (as `mixer_set_pad_cue`). Not main.

### mixer_pad_meter

```odin
mixer_pad_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (Meter, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s meter now (after its fader). Poll it: it isn't reported.

### mixer_bus_meter

```odin
mixer_bus_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, bus: i64) -> (Meter, Result)
```

Bus `bus`'s (or MAIN's) meter now.

### mixer_cue_meter

```odin
mixer_cue_meter :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Meter, Result)
```

The cue mix's meter now.

### mixer_input_meter

```odin
mixer_input_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, pair: i64) -> (Meter, Result)
```

The interface's input pair `pair`'s meter now (0: inputs 1/2).

### mixer_loudness

```odin
mixer_loudness :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Loudness, Result)
```

Main's loudness and stereo now.

### mixer_loudness_reset

```odin
mixer_loudness_reset :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Starts main's integrated loudness and true peak again.

### mixer_pad_latency

```odin
mixer_pad_latency :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

Frames pad `pad`'s inserts delay it (the others are delayed to match).

## Pads

### pad_state


Pad `pad` now. Not_Found out of 0..PADS-1.

### pad_name

```odin
pad_name :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s name: its own, else its sound's ("" for an empty pad). Temporary.

### pad_label

```odin
pad_label :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s label as the pads show it ("A1"..."H16"). Temporary.

### pad_set_name

```odin
pad_set_name :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Names pad `pad` (up to 31 bytes; "": its sound's name again), undoably.

### pad_set_color

```odin
pad_set_color :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, color: i64) -> Result
```

Colours pad `pad` (0xRRGGBB), undoably.

### pad_set_mode

```odin
pad_set_mode :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, mode: Pad_Mode) -> Result
```

How pad `pad`'s sample plays when hit, undoably.

### pad_set_volume

```odin
pad_set_volume :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, db: f32) -> Result
```

Pad `pad`'s fader (-60..6 dB), undoably (a gesture's moves merge).

### pad_set_pan

```odin
pad_set_pan :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, pan: f32) -> Result
```

Pad `pad`'s pan (-1 left .. 1 right), undoably.

### pad_set_pitch

```odin
pad_set_pitch :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, semitones: f32) -> Result
```

Pad `pad`'s transpose (-24..24 semitones), undoably.

### pad_set_mute

```odin
pad_set_mute :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, on: bool) -> Result
```

Mutes pad `pad` or not, undoably.

### pad_set_solo

```odin
pad_set_solo :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, on: bool) -> Result
```

Solos pad `pad` or not, undoably.

### pad_set_choke

```odin
pad_set_choke :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, group: i64) -> Result
```

Puts pad `pad` in choke group `group` (1..6; 0: none): a pad of the group hit silences the others. Undoably.

### pad_set_monitor

```odin
pad_set_monitor :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, monitor: Monitor) -> Result
```

When pad `pad`'s input is heard, undoably.

### pad_set_kind

```odin
pad_set_kind :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, kind: Pad_Kind) -> Result
```

Makes pad `pad` a `kind`: a sampler (a slicer's slices kept), a slicer (of its sample, or empty), the synth, or an audio track. Undoably. Unsupported for Plugin (load one: devices).

### pad_load_sample

```odin
pad_load_sample :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, path: string) -> Result
```

Loads the audio file at `path` onto pad `pad` (a sampler pad's sample), undoably. Io_Error if it can't be read.

### pad_clear

```odin
pad_clear :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> Result
```

Clears pad `pad` (its sound, its settings), undoably.

### pad_duplicate

```odin
pad_duplicate :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

Copies pad `pad` onto the next empty pad after it: which one. Not_Found if none is empty.

### pad_copy_to

```odin
pad_copy_to :: proc(api: ^Api, from: i64, to: i64) -> Result
```

Copies pad `from` onto pad `to` (all of it: its sound and settings), undoably.

### pad_play

```odin
pad_play :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, on: bool, velocity: f32 = 1) -> Result
```

Plays pad `pad` (`on`) or lets it go, at `velocity` (0..1], as a hit on it does (its mode, its choke group).

### pad_set_armed

```odin
pad_set_armed :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, on: bool) -> Result
```

Arms pad `pad` to record (or not): an audio track records its input, any other pad what its MIDI input plays.

### pad_input

```odin
pad_input :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (Pad_Input, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s audio input.

### pad_set_input

```odin
pad_set_input :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, input: Pad_Input) -> Result
```

Sets pad `pad`'s audio input, undoably.

## Parameters, by reference

### param_count

```odin
param_count :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref) -> (i64, Result)
```

Parameters device `ref` has now (`ref.param` ignored; `param_at` lists them). Not_Found if the device isn't there (an empty pad, an empty slot).

### param_at

```odin
param_at :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref, index: i64) -> (Param_Ref, Result)
```

Device `ref`'s parameter `index` (in its order) as a reference.

### param_info

```odin
param_info :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref) -> (Param_Info, Result)
```

What parameter `ref` is: its range, default, unit, steps.

### param_name

```odin
param_name :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref) -> (string, Result)
```

Parameter `ref`'s name ("Cutoff", "Volume"). Temporary.

### param_get

```odin
param_get :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref) -> (f64, Result)
```

Parameter `ref`'s value now, in its plain units (as the project keeps it: not what automation moves it to while it plays).

### param_set

```odin
param_set :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref, value: f64) -> Result
```

Sets parameter `ref` to `value` (plain units, in its range), undoably: each call a step, or one for a touch (`param_touch`) or a gesture.

### param_text

```odin
param_text :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref) -> (string, Result)
```

Parameter `ref`'s value as the UI shows it ("-6.0 dB", "1.2 kHz"). Temporary.

### param_touch

```odin
param_touch :: proc(api: ^Api, ref: Param_Ref, on: bool) -> Result
```

Begins (`on`) or ends touching parameter `ref`, as a knob is held: its moves until let go are one undo step, and with automation recording armed, they are written while it plays. One parameter is touched at a time (touching another lets the first go).

## Perform: play modes, banks, the selected pad, keys

```odin
perform_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Perform_State, Result)
```

How the pads play now.

```odin
perform_set_play_mode :: proc(api: ^Api, mode: Play_Mode) -> Result
```

Plays the pads as `mode` (the pads held let go first; Keyboard opens on the bank holding the pad's own note).


Shows bank `bank` (0..7) of the pads.


Selects pad `pad` (in Pads mode, its bank shown).

### perform_set_keys


Keyboard mode's scale, root (0..11), octave (-3..3) and chord. Saved with the project (not an edit).

## Project: new, open, save, templates, clean up

### project_state

```odin
project_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Project_State, Result)
```

The project now.

### project_dir

```odin
project_dir :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

The project's folder (an untitled one's is in the unsaved folder). Temporary.

### project_name

```odin
project_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

The project's name: its folder's, without ".pads" ("Untitled" before it is saved). Temporary.

### project_new

```odin
project_new :: proc(api: ^Api, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

A new, empty project. With changes not saved, Busy unless `discard_changes` (they are lost; an untitled project's folder goes).

### project_new_from_template

```odin
project_new_from_template :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

A new, untitled project from the template called `name`. Not_Found if there is none; Busy with changes not saved unless `discard_changes`.

### project_open

```odin
project_open :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

Opens the project in folder `dir`. Not_Found if there is none there; Busy with changes not saved unless `discard_changes`.

### project_save

```odin
project_save :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Saves the project where it is (an untitled one stays untitled, in the unsaved folder: `project_save_as` gives it a place).

### project_save_as

```odin
project_save_as :: proc(api: ^Api, path: string, replace: bool = false) -> Result
```

Saves the project as folder `path` (".pads" added when missing), which it is from now on. Invalid_Argument if something is there already, unless `replace` (the project is written into that folder).

### project_rename

```odin
project_rename :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Renames the project's folder to "<name>.pads", where it is. Unsupported for an untitled project (save it as); Invalid_Argument for a name a folder can't have, or one taken.

### project_recent

```odin
project_recent :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Recent project `index`'s folder (0: the latest). Temporary.

### project_template_name

```odin
project_template_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Template `index`'s name (in name order). Temporary.

### project_save_template

```odin
project_save_template :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Saves a copy of the project as template `name` (one of that name is replaced). New projects can start from it.

### project_recover

```odin
project_recover :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string) -> Result
```

Opens the backup the project in `dir` left when Pads stopped without closing (its changes, not yet saved). Not_Found if it left none.

### project_discard_backup

```odin
project_discard_backup :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string) -> Result
```

Throws away the backup the project in `dir` left (an unsaved project's folder with it).

### project_unused_files

```odin
project_unused_files :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Unused_Files, Result)
```

The files in the project's folder it doesn't use now, by kind.

### project_clean_up

```odin
project_clean_up :: proc(api: ^Api, undo_only: bool, cache: bool) -> (Clean_Up, Result)
```

Moves the files the project doesn't use to the Trash (from where they can be put back) and saves it: those nothing uses, and with `undo_only` the samples only undo would bring back (undo is forgotten), with `cache` the renderings. Io_Error if some couldn't be moved.

## Recording: Rec, sampling into pads

### recording_state

```odin
recording_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Recording_State, Result)
```

Recording now.

### recording_record

```odin
recording_record :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Arms Rec (or disarms it). Armed while stopped, it starts playing, after the count-in if there is one (transport_set_count_in).

### recording_sample_start

```odin
recording_sample_start :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, method: Sampling, threshold_db: f32 = -40, bars: i64 = 1) -> Result
```

Records a sample into pad `pad` from its input (its strip's In), by `method` (Threshold: from `threshold_db`, -80..0; Bars: `bars`, 1..16). It lands on the pad (one undo step) when it stops. Unsupported when the pad has no input or there is no audio input.

### recording_sample_stop

```odin
recording_sample_stop :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Stops the sample being recorded (Hold, Threshold; Bars stop by themselves). Not_Found when none is.

## Sequencer: sequences, notes, CC, automation, quantize, note repeat, the arpeggiator

### sequence_current

```odin
sequence_current :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

The sequence shown and played (Pattern).

### sequence_state

```odin
sequence_state :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> (Sequence_State, Result)
```

Sequence `slot` now.

### sequence_name

```odin
sequence_name :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Sequence `slot`'s name: its own, else "Sequence N". Temporary.

### sequence_select

```odin
sequence_select :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> Result
```

Shows and plays sequence `slot`: at once when stopped; playing, when the launch quantize says. Not an edit.

### sequence_set_name

```odin
sequence_set_name :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Names sequence `slot` (up to 23 bytes; "": "Sequence N" again), undoably.

### sequence_set_bars

```odin
sequence_set_bars :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, bars: i64) -> Result
```

Sets sequence `slot`'s length (1..64 bars), undoably. Notes past the end are kept (they come back if it grows) but don't play.

### sequence_set_tempo

```odin
sequence_set_tempo :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, bpm: f64) -> Result
```

Gives sequence `slot` its own tempo (40..300 BPM; 0: the project's), undoably.

### sequence_set_color

```odin
sequence_set_color :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, color: i64) -> Result
```

Colours sequence `slot` (0xRRGGBB; 0: its slot's), undoably.


Swings sequence `slot`'s off-beats of `grid` (Eighth or Sixteenth) by `amount` (0..1), undoably.

### sequence_quantize

```odin
sequence_quantize :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, grid: Grid, strength: f64 = 1) -> Result
```

Moves sequence `slot`'s notes toward `grid` by `strength` (0..1; 1: onto it), undoably.

### sequence_duplicate

```odin
sequence_duplicate :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

Copies sequence `slot` (all of it, named "… copy") into the next empty slot and shows it: which. Not_Found when every slot is used.

### sequence_copy

```odin
sequence_copy :: proc(api: ^Api, from: i64, to: i64) -> Result
```

Copies sequence `from` onto slot `to` (what was there replaced), undoably.

### sequence_double

```odin
sequence_double :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> Result
```

Doubles sequence `slot`: twice as long, its notes and automation again in the new half. Undoably; Invalid_Argument past 64 bars.

### sequence_clear

```odin
sequence_clear :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64) -> Result
```

Empties sequence `slot` (its notes and automation), undoably.

### sequence_set_track_loop

```odin
sequence_set_track_loop :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, beats: f64) -> Result
```

Pad `pad`'s own loop in sequence `slot`: `beats` long (0, or the sequence's length or more: none). Undoably.

### sequence_note

```odin
sequence_note :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, index: i64) -> (Note, Result)
```

Note `index` of sequence `slot` (in order: by start, then pad).

### sequence_add_note

```odin
sequence_add_note :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, n: Note) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds note `n` to sequence `slot` (where it overlaps one of its pad's and pitch, the new one wins): its index. Undoably.

### sequence_set_note

```odin
sequence_set_note :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, index: i64, n: Note) -> (i64, Result)
```

Changes note `index` of sequence `slot` to `n`: its index now (notes stay in order). Undoably (a gesture's moves merge).

### sequence_remove_notes

```odin
sequence_remove_notes :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, indices: []i64) -> Result
```

Removes the notes `indices` of sequence `slot`: one undo step.

### sequence_cc

```odin
sequence_cc :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, index: i64) -> (Cc, Result)
```

MIDI CC step `index` of sequence `slot` (by pad, controller, beat).

### sequence_add_cc

```odin
sequence_add_cc :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, c: Cc) -> Result
```

Adds MIDI CC step `c` to sequence `slot`, undoably.

### sequence_clear_cc

```odin
sequence_clear_cc :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, cc: i64, from: f64, to: f64) -> Result
```

Removes the MIDI CC steps of pad `pad`'s controller `cc` in sequence `slot` from beat `from` to `to`, undoably.

### sequence_point

```odin
sequence_point :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, index: i64) -> (Point, Result)
```

Automation point `index` of sequence `slot` (by lane, then beat).

### sequence_add_point

```odin
sequence_add_point :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, ref: Param_Ref, beat: f64, value: f32, curve: f32 = 0) -> Result
```

Adds a point to parameter `ref`'s automation in sequence `slot`: at `beat`, `value` (its units, in its range), `curve` (-1..1) to the next. Undoably.

### sequence_add_pad_point

```odin
sequence_add_pad_point :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, pad: i64, lane: Pad_Lane, beat: f64, value: f32, curve: f32 = 0) -> Result
```

Adds a point to pad `pad`'s own `lane` in sequence `slot`. Undoably.

### sequence_remove_point

```odin
sequence_remove_point :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, index: i64) -> Result
```

Removes automation point `index` of sequence `slot`, undoably.

### sequence_set_input_quantize

```odin
sequence_set_input_quantize :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool, grid: Grid, strength: f32, swing: f32) -> Result
```

Input quantize: notes recorded move toward `grid` by `strength` (0..1), its off-beats swung by `swing` (0..1). Undoably.

### sequence_midi_fx

```odin
sequence_midi_fx :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64) -> (Midi_Fx, Result)
```

Pad `pad`'s note repeat and arpeggiator.

### sequence_set_midi_fx

```odin
sequence_set_midi_fx :: proc(api: ^Api, pad: i64, fx: Midi_Fx) -> Result
```

Sets pad `pad`'s note repeat and arpeggiator, undoably.

Settings there are (settings_name lists them).


Setting `index`'s name: "section.key", as settings.ini has it ("project.tempo", "midi.sync"). Temporary.


What setting `name` is: its kind, its group, its range or choices.

### settings_about


What setting `name` does, in a few words. Temporary.

### settings_choice


Choice `index` of setting `name` ("Midi_Clock"). Temporary.


Setting `name` as a number: a Bool's 0 or 1, a Choice's index (a Text's 0).


Setting `name` as text: "true", "120", a choice's name, a folder. Temporary.


```odin
settings_set_text :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, value: string) -> Result
```

## Song: clips, lanes, tempo and meter lanes, markers, the loop, arrangements

### song_state

```odin
song_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Song_State, Result)
```

The song now.

### song_clip

```odin
song_clip :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (Song_Clip, Result)
```

Clip `index` of the song.

### song_clip_label

```odin
song_clip_label :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Clip `index`'s label ("Verse"; "" none). Temporary.

### song_add

```odin
song_add :: proc(api: ^Api, slot: i64, lane: i64 = 0, at: f64 = -1, length: f64 = 0, repeats: i64 = 1) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds sequence `slot` to the song on lane `lane`: at beat `at` (-1: after the lane's last clip), `length` beats long (0: the sequence `repeats` times). Its index. Undoably; Busy when the song is full.

### song_set_clip

```odin
song_set_clip :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64, c: Song_Clip) -> Result
```

Sets clip `index` (its sequence, place, length, part, transpose, mute), undoably (a gesture's moves merge).

### song_remove_clips

```odin
song_remove_clips :: proc(api: ^Api, indices: []i64) -> Result
```

Removes the clips `indices`: one undo step.

### song_duplicate_clips

```odin
song_duplicate_clips :: proc(api: ^Api, indices: []i64) -> (i64, Result)
```

Copies the clips `indices` right after themselves (the selection's span later): one undo step. How many were copied (as many as fit): they are the song's last clips now.

### song_clear

```odin
song_clear :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Empties the song (its clips; its lanes, tempo, meters and markers too), undoably.

### song_merge_sequence

```odin
song_merge_sequence :: proc(api: ^Api, from: i64, to: i64) -> Result
```

Merges sequence `from`'s notes and automation into sequence `to` (as long as the longer), undoably.

### song_move_clips

```odin
song_move_clips :: proc(api: ^Api, indices: []i64, beats: f64, lanes: i64) -> Result
```

Moves the clips `indices` by `beats` and `lanes`: one undo step (the earliest stays at 0 or later, the top lane at 0 or lower).

### song_lane

```odin
song_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> (Song_Lane, Result)
```

Song lane `lane`.

### song_lane_name

```odin
song_lane_name :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Song lane `lane`'s name (its own, else "Lane N"). Temporary.

### song_add_lane

```odin
song_add_lane :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds a song lane at the bottom: its number. Busy at 16.

### song_set_lane

```odin
song_set_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64, l: Song_Lane) -> Result
```

Mutes or solos song lane `lane`, undoably.

### song_rename_lane

```odin
song_rename_lane :: proc(api: ^Api, lane: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Names song lane `lane` (up to 15 bytes), undoably.

### song_tempo_point

```odin
song_tempo_point :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (Tempo_Point, Result)
```

Tempo point `index` of the song's tempo lane.

### song_add_tempo_point

```odin
song_add_tempo_point :: proc(api: ^Api, t: Tempo_Point) -> Result
```

Adds a point to the song's tempo lane (one at its beat replaced), undoably.

### song_remove_tempo_point

```odin
song_remove_tempo_point :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> Result
```

Removes tempo point `index` (the first only when it is the last left), undoably.

### song_meter

```odin
song_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (Time_Signature, Result)
```

Time signature change `index` of the song.

### song_set_meter

```odin
song_set_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, beat: f64, num: i64, den: i64) -> Result
```

Changes the song's time signature from `beat` on, undoably.

### song_remove_meter

```odin
song_remove_meter :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> Result
```

Removes time signature change `index`, undoably.

### song_marker

```odin
song_marker :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (f64, Result)
```

Marker `index`'s beat.

### song_marker_name

```odin
song_marker_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Marker `index`'s name. Temporary.

### song_add_marker

```odin
song_add_marker :: proc(api: ^Api, beat: f64, name: string) -> (i64, Result)
```

Adds a marker named `name` at `beat`: its index (markers are in order). Undoably; Busy when there are 32.

### song_rename_marker

```odin
song_rename_marker :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Renames marker `index`, undoably.

### song_remove_marker

```odin
song_remove_marker :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> Result
```

Removes marker `index`, undoably.

### song_set_loop

```odin

```

Loops beats `start`..`end` of the song (`on`), or the whole song, undoably.

### song_jump


Song mode: plays from song beat `beat` (playing), or makes it where play starts (stopped).

### song_arrangement_name

```odin
song_arrangement_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Arrangement `index`'s name. Temporary.

### song_select_arrangement

```odin
song_select_arrangement :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> Result
```

Makes arrangement `index` the song, undoably.

### song_add_arrangement


A new arrangement (empty, or a copy of `copy_of`), made the song: its index. Busy when there are as many as can be.

### song_rename_arrangement

```odin
song_rename_arrangement :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64, name: string) -> Result
```

Renames arrangement `index`, undoably.

### song_delete_arrangement

## Changes

### subscribe

```odin
subscribe :: proc(api: ^Api, topic: Topic, index: i64, callback: Change_Proc, user: rawptr) -> (Subscription, Result)
```

Calls `callback` with `user` when `topic` changes (`index`: only for that pad, bus...; -1: all). Control thread. Unsupported for a topic this version doesn't report (see `TOPICS`).

### unsubscribe

```odin
unsubscribe :: proc(api: ^Api, sub: Subscription) -> Result
```

Stops subscription `sub`. Not_Found if there is none. Control thread (a callback may unsubscribe itself).

## Transport

### transport_state

```odin
transport_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Transport_State, Result)
```

The transport now.

### transport_play

```odin
transport_play :: proc(api: ^Api, from_beat: f64 = 0, count_in: bool = false) -> Result
```

Starts playing from beat `from_beat` of what plays (the sequence shown, or the song from its cue at 0); with `count_in`, the count-in's bars of click first. Playing already, it starts again from there.

### transport_stop

```odin
transport_stop :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Stops (back to the top) and disarms Rec. Stopped already, it does nothing more.

### transport_toggle

```odin
transport_toggle :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Plays if stopped, stops if playing (the Space key).

### transport_silence

```odin
transport_silence :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Silences every sound at once (a fade of a few milliseconds), playing or not: what pressing Stop twice does.

### transport_set_tempo

```odin
transport_set_tempo :: proc(api: ^Api, bpm: f64) -> Result
```

Sets the tempo (40..300 BPM), undoably.

### transport_tap

```odin
transport_tap :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (f64, Result)
```

One tap of tap tempo, now (the app's clock): returns the tempo the taps so far make, set (to a tenth), or 0 until there are two. The fourth tap stopped starts playing a beat later; a pause of 2 s starts again.

### transport_set_loop

```odin
transport_set_loop :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Loops (it goes round) or plays once and stops, undoably.

### transport_set_count_in

```odin
transport_set_count_in :: proc(api: ^Api, bars: i64) -> Result
```

Sets the bars of click before recording (0..2), undoably.

### transport_set_time_signature

```odin
transport_set_time_signature :: proc(api: ^Api, num: i64, den: i64) -> Result
```

Sets the time signature: `num` beats (1..16) of 1/`den` (2, 4, 8 or 16), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome

```odin
transport_set_metronome :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Turns the metronome on or off (the app's, not the project's: not undoable).

### transport_set_metronome_level

```odin
transport_set_metronome_level :: proc(api: ^Api, db: f32) -> Result
```

Sets the metronome's level (-48..6 dB), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_sound

```odin
transport_set_metronome_sound :: proc(api: ^Api, sound: Metronome_Sound) -> Result
```

Sets the metronome's sound, undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_accent

```odin
transport_set_metronome_accent :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Accents the bar's first beat (or clicks it as the others), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_recording_only

```odin
transport_set_metronome_recording_only :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Clicks only while recording and counting in (or always when on), undoably.

### transport_set_song_mode

```odin
transport_set_song_mode :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Plays the song (true) or the sequence shown (false: Pattern).

### transport_set_sync

```odin
transport_set_sync :: proc(api: ^Api, sync: Sync) -> Result
```

Follows `sync` for the tempo, start and stop (the setting "midi.sync": saved with the settings, not the project). Link not built in: Internal.

### transport_set_clock_out

```odin
transport_set_clock_out :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Sends MIDI clock to the output port, or stops (the setting "midi.clock_out").

## Types

### Result

What a call came to. `last_error` says why it wasn't `Ok`.

`Ok`, `Not_Found`, `Invalid_Argument`, `Busy`, `Unsupported`, `Io_Error`

### Audio_Warp

How an audio track's part follows a tempo it wasn't recorded at.

`Repitch`, `Stretch`

### Effect_Place

Where an effect slot is.

`Insert`, `Bus`, `Main`, `Perf`

### Key_Kind

What a compressor's or gate's sidechain listens to.

`None`, `Pad`, `Bus`

### Export_Source

What an export renders.

`Sequence`, `Song`

### Export_Stems

A mixdown, or stems.

`Mixdown`, `Pads`, `Buses`

### Export_Format

An export's file format.

`Int16`, `Int24`, `Float32`

### Midi_Import

How a MIDI file's notes go onto pads.

`Drums`, `By_Map`, `On_Pad`

### Launch_Quantize

When a sequence launched while playing takes over.

`End`, `Bar`, `Beat`, `Now`

### Midi_In_Mode

What MIDI plays a pad.

`All`, `None`, `Port`

### Output_Kind

Where a pad or a bus plays.

`Main`, `Bus`, `Pair`

### Pad_Kind

What a pad is.

`Sampler`, `Audio`, `Slicer`, `Synth`, `Plugin`

### Pad_Mode

How a pad's sample plays when hit.

`One_Shot`, `Gate`, `Loop`, `Hold`

### Monitor

When a pad's input is heard.

`Auto`, `In`, `Off`

### Input_From

Where a pad's audio input comes from.

`Interface`, `Pad`, `Bus`, `Main`, `None`

### Track

Whose parameter.

`None`, `Pad`, `Bus`, `Main`

### Device

Which of a track's devices.

`Sound`, `Insert`, `Volume`, `Pan`, `Send`, `Eq`

### Param_Unit

What a parameter's values are in.

`None`, `Decibels`, `Hertz`, `Milliseconds`, `Percent`, `Semitones`, `Ratio`

### Play_Mode

How the pads play.

`Pads`, `Keyboard`, `Velocity`

### Scale

Keyboard mode's scales.

`Chromatic`, `Major`, `Minor`, `Dorian`, `Mixolydian`, `Harmonic_Minor`, `Major_Pentatonic`, `Minor_Pentatonic`, `Blues`

### Chord

Keyboard mode's chords (one pad, several notes).

`Off`, `Triad`, `Seventh`, `Power`

### Sampling

How a sample is recorded into a pad.

`Hold`, `Arm`, `Threshold`, `Bars`

### Grid

A grid: quantize, swing, input quantize, note repeat and the arpeggiator step by one.

`Quarter`, `Eighth`, `Eighth_Triplet`, `Sixteenth`, `Sixteenth_Triplet`, `Thirty_Second`, `Thirty_Second_Triplet`, `Sixty_Fourth`

### Pad_Lane

A pad's own automation lane (beside any parameter: a Param_Ref).

`Volume`, `Pitch`, `Eq_Low`, `Eq_Mid`, `Eq_High`, `Cutoff`, `Resonance`

### Arp_Mode

How the arpeggiator walks the held notes.

`Up`, `Down`, `Up_Down`, `Random`, `As_Played`

### Setting_Kind

What a setting is (`settings_info`).

`Bool`, `Int`, `Number`, `Choice`, `Text`

### Setting_Group

What part of Pads a setting changes (applied when it is set: the audio device reopened, the MIDI ports, what the tempo follows...).

`Appearance`, `Audio`, `Midi`, `Sync`, `Recording`, `Project`, `Plugins`

### Topic

What a subscriber hears about. Topics whose module isn't built yet answer `subscribe` with `Unsupported`.

`Transport`, `History`, `Selection`, `Pad`, `Mixer`, `Sequence`, `Song`, `Launcher`, `Project`, `Settings`, `Recording`, `Ui`

### Metronome_Sound

The metronome's sound.

`Beep`, `Wood`, `Stick`, `Cowbell`

### Sync

What the tempo, start and stop follow.

`Internal`, `Midi_Clock`, `Link`

### Part_State

Audio track `pad`'s part in sequence `slot`: its takes, the regions that play them, how it follows the tempo.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `regions` | `i64` | audio_region 0..regions-1 (in order along the sequence) |
| `takes` | `i64` | takes recorded or added |
| `beats` | `f64` | how long it plays (its own loop, or the sequence) |
| `warp` | `Audio_Warp` |  |
| `transpose` | `f32` | semitones (Stretch) |

### Region

A region: part of a take, placed in the sequence.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `take` | `i64` | which of the part's takes it plays |
| `at` | `f64` | where it starts: beats into the sequence |
| `start` | `i64` | the take's frames it plays: from |
| `end` | `i64` | ... to |
| `gain_db` | `f32` |  |
| `pan` | `f32` | -1..1 |
| `fade_in` | `f32` | seconds |
| `fade_out` | `f32` | seconds |
| `mute` | `bool` |  |
| `reverse` | `bool` |  |

### Browser_State

The Library's browser now.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `tab` | `i64` | the favourite shown (browser_favorite_name) |
| `favorites` | `i64` | its favourites (the project's folder among them) |
| `rows` | `i64` | the folder tree as shown (browser_row) |
| `can_back` | `bool` |  |
| `can_forward` | `bool` |  |
| `results` | `i64` | a search's results so far (browser_result) |
| `searching` | `bool` | a search is under way |
| `previewing` | `bool` | a file is being previewed |

### Browser_Row

A row of the browser's tree, or a search result.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `is_dir` | `bool` |  |
| `depth` | `i64` | in the tree: 0 under the root |

### Preview_Settings

Preview settings: it plays a file chosen (auto), stretched to the tempo (sync), at `volume_db`.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_play` | `bool` |  |
| `sync` | `bool` |  |
| `volume_db` | `f32` | -60..6 |

### Slot_Ref

An effect slot.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `place` | `Effect_Place` |  |
| `index` | `i64` | the pad, the bus, the performance effect |
| `slot` | `i64` |  |

### Effect_State

What is in a slot.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `i64` | its effect kind (effect_kind_name; 0: empty) |
| `on` | `bool` | on (off: bypassed) |
| `plugin` | `bool` | a CLAP plug-in (its name: effect_name) |

### Key_State

What the effect in slot `s` listens to (a compressor's, a gate's), and how.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `Key_Kind` |  |
| `index` | `i64` | the pad or the bus |
| `hpf_hz` | `f32` | the key's high-pass (0: none) |
| `listen` | `bool` | the track plays the key instead (to set it by) |

### Export_Settings

How to export.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | `Export_Source` |  |
| `stems` | `Export_Stems` |  |
| `format` | `Export_Format` |  |
| `rate` | `f64` | 44100, 48000 or 96000 (0: the engine's) |
| `tail` | `f64` | seconds after the end, for reverb and echoes to ring out (0..10) |

### Export_State

The export under way, or the last one.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `busy` | `bool` | under way (a slice a frame) |
| `progress` | `f64` | 0..1 |
| `failed` | `bool` | the last one failed (a file couldn't be written) |
| `files` | `i64` | files the last one wrote (export_file) |
| `made_pad` | `i64` | the pad the last bounce, resample or bounce in place made (-1: none) |

### History_State

The undo history now: steps that can be undone and redone, and whether the project has changed since it was saved.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `undo_steps` | `i64` | steps that can be undone |
| `redo_steps` | `i64` | steps undone that can be redone |
| `dirty` | `bool` | changed since it was saved |
| `grouping` | `bool` | a group is open (history_group_begin) |

### Launcher_State

The launcher now.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lanes` | `i64` | lanes 0..lanes-1 |
| `quantize` | `Launch_Quantize` |  |
| `hold` | `bool` | sequence pads play while held (else a press launches) |
| `continue_` | `bool` | a launch carries on where the playhead is in its lane |
| `recording` | `bool` | launches are recorded into the song |

### Lane_State

Lane `lane` now.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `i64` | its sequences (rows 0..rows-1) |
| `color` | `i64` | 0xRRGGBB (0: its default) |
| `playing` | `i64` | the sequence it plays (-1: none) |
| `queued` | `i64` | the sequence about to take over (-1: none) |
| `beats_to_switch` | `f64` | until the queued one takes over |

### Place

Where a sequence is in the launcher.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lane` | `i64` |  |
| `row` | `i64` |  |

### Midi_Port

A MIDI port the system has.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | `bool` | a source (else a destination) |
| `open` | `bool` | an input Pads listens to |

### Pad_Midi

A pad's MIDI input and output.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `in_mode` | `Midi_In_Mode` |  |
| `in_channel` | `i64` | 0: any; 1..16 |
| `out` | `bool` | its hits also go out as MIDI |
| `out_channel` | `i64` | 0..15 |
| `out_key` | `i64` | the note it sends |

### Output

Where a pad or a bus plays.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `Output_Kind` |  |
| `index` | `i64` |  |

### Mixer_State

The mixer now.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `buses` | `i64` | buses in use (0..buses-1) |
| `total_latency` | `i64` | frames the whole mix runs behind (compensated) |

Bus `bus` (0..buses-1, or MAIN) now (its name: mixer_bus_name).

| `mute` | `bool` |  |

A meter's reading now (linear: 1 is full scale).

Pad `pad` now (its name: `pad_name`).
